title: [YSQL] Index scan return in correct results for count(1/*)
body:
Jira Link: [DB-5983](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-5983)
### Description

 Index scan return in correct results for count(1/*) .

**Example:** 

```
create table test(k int primary key, v int);
insert into test select i, i from generate_series(1,1000) as i;
```

**Output using the seq_scan.**

```
yugabyte=#  select count(1) from test;
 count
-------
  1000
(1 row)
```

**Turn of the seq_scan and count(1)/count(*) returns 0 rows **

```
yugabyte=# set enable_seqscan to off ;
SET
yugabyte=#  select count(1) from test;                                                                  
 count
-------
     0
(1 row)

yugabyte=# explain (analyze, dist) select count(1) from test;
                                                            QUERY PLAN

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------
 Aggregate  (cost=116.50..116.51 rows=1 width=8) (actual time=35.370..35.371 rows=1 loops=1)
   ->  Index Only Scan using test_pkey on test  (cost=0.00..114.00 rows=1000 width=0) (actual time=35.346..35.346 rows=0 loops=1)
         Heap Fetches: 0
         Storage Index Read Requests: 2
         Storage Index Execution Time: 34.002 ms
 Planning Time: 0.166 ms
 Execution Time: 35.571 ms
 Storage Read Requests: 2
 Storage Write Requests: 0
 Storage Execution Time: 34.002 ms
 Peak Memory Usage: 8 kB
(11 rows)


yugabyte=#  select count(*) from test;
 count
-------
     0
(1 row)

yugabyte=# explain (analyze, dist) select count(*) from test;
                                                            QUERY PLAN

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-------------------
 Aggregate  (cost=116.50..116.51 rows=1 width=8) (actual time=36.016..36.016 rows=1 loops=1)
   ->  Index Only Scan using test_pkey on test  (cost=0.00..114.00 rows=1000 width=0) (actual time=36.002..36.0
02 rows=0 loops=1)
         Heap Fetches: 0
         Storage Index Read Requests: 2
         Storage Index Execution Time: 35.002 ms
 Planning Time: 0.187 ms
 Execution Time: 36.211 ms
 Storage Read Requests: 2
 Storage Write Requests: 0
 Storage Execution Time: 35.002 ms
 Peak Memory Usage: 8 kB
(11 rows)
```
